summary: Final: score heldout once with the chosen KNN; write cv_auc, holdout_auc, gap flat
reasoning: Final run of the same, unchanged analysis with --final. It re-runs the identical nested CV on pilot (expected to reproduce cv_auc 0.8568 from my pilot-only run, well above the 0.80 floor), then — and only then — fits the inner-CV-chosen configuration (raw + pairwise products, F-screen top 10, k=81, distance weighting) on all 1000 pilot rows and opens data/heldout.csv exactly once to score the 3000 unseen samples. Evidence the transfer should hold: the completed r1 trails each cleared holdout 0.80 with agreement (pairs-holdout and forest-holdout milestones are sealed; the map records boost cv 0.8343 transferring too). I expect holdout_auc >= 0.80 and gap within ±0.05; the run writes the flat metrics {cv_auc, holdout_auc, gap} to out/metrics.json.
